{{Quote|Our orders are to recover debris samples to confirm a report that the enemy battleship was built by Quarren Separatists at the Pammant Docks.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]]|<ref name="Breakout Squad">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref>}}
The '''Pammant Docks'''<ref name="RotSICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref><ref name="TCSWE" /> were a ring-shaped [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]]. The shipyard was crewed by members of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==History==
{{Quote|Well, I'll be. The insignia for the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps! If that doesn't confirm the battleship was built at Pammant, I don't know what does.|Clone Captain Lock, during an inspection of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} wreckage|<ref name="Breakout Squad" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Pammant Docks were one of the most valuable shipyard of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The shipyard was operated by the Quarren engineers of the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> who manufactured [[Frigate/Legends|assault frigates]] and [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruisers]] there for the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was at Pammant Docks that were produced [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|tradefederationcruiser|Trade Federation cruiser}}</ref> including [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="TCSWE" /> The shipyards were most famous for constructing the massive [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruisers]],<ref name="Strongholds" /> including the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] and the ''[[Devastation]]''.<ref name="TCWIV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> Following the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destruction]] of the ''Malevolence'', [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[Breakout Squad]] were tasked to search through the cruiser's debris to found evidence that the warship had been constructed by the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps at Pammant.<ref name="Breakout Squad" /> Near the end of the Clone Wars,<ref name="Strongholds" /> the Pammant shipyard was attacked by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Destruction of Pammant|battle]], the Republic [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] ''[[Quaestor]]'s'' was damaged and collided with the planet.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The accident bathed the shipyards and the planet in [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], killing every living being in both locations.<ref name="Strongholds" />
